fields.label: Check Spotify every (seconds)
fields.description: How often PyDeck asks Spotify what is playing, to pick up changes made elsewhere, like a skip on your phone or a pause in the app. Lower reacts faster but uses more of your Spotify app's request quota. With nothing playing it checks every 30 seconds at most.

fields.label: Start playback on
fields.description: Where Play / Pause starts the music when Spotify no longer has an active device, which happens a few minutes after playback stops. Spotify has to be open on that device. Automatic uses the device that played last. Music already playing or paused on a device stays there.

fields.label: Keep album art while paused
fields.description: Play / Pause keeps showing the song's art when you pause, until playback resumes or a different song starts.
